movies.title: Tears of Steel
movies.description: In a future Amsterdam, a group of warriors and scientists gather at the Oude Kerk to stage a desperate attempt to rescue the world from destructive robots.

movies.title: Big Buck Bunny
movies.description: A giant, gentle rabbit is pushed too far by three bullying rodents and decides to teach them a lesson they will never forget.

movies.title: Elephants Dream
movies.description: Two men, the old Proog and the young Emo, explore a vast, surreal machine world that seems to have a mind of its own.
